purpose: Define checklist fields that can populate the Phase 1B Canonical Coil Model without implementing a drawing populator.

field_value_shape.canonical_path: JSON Pointer path into the canonical model.
field_value_shape.value: User-entered, imported, extracted, or reviewed value.
field_value_shape.unit: Optional unit, null when not applicable.
field_value_shape.source_trace: Array of source evidence entries. Required even when empty.
field_value_shape.review_status: draft, source_observed, ai_inferred, john_confirmed, engineering_review_required, validated, not_applicable, missing, or future.

payload_contract.source_trace_policy: Checklist values must carry source_trace when they come from EZ Coil data, submittal PDFs, imported JSON, or John/engineering review. Manually entered values should use source_type checklist.

field_roles.required: Needed for the Direct Coil review workflow or minimum canonical model identity.
field_roles.optional: Useful when present but not required for the initial model draft.
field_roles.derived: Should be generated by an explicit reviewed rule or imported from trusted source data; not manually invented.
field_roles.future: Reserved for later submittal extraction, import/export, validation, or selection workflow work.
